book.name: Lucas
book.title: Evangelio según Lucas Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Lucasdë

content: Zaqueo
E irgo ga Jesús opzrëno jek Jericó kjokyo roshko, tur pjl̈or kal̈ëkong wl̈o l̈e.
Domer sök eshko kjl̈ara ko Zaqueo, e dbur ara. E parkë shäng dbur töngga Roma so kong l̈i kägäyo.
Jesús, e sorë ĩya woydë. Gueniyo domer l̈i sok chirawa töshko, ga oba ara. E kjĩshko ga ĩya ga äe.
Eni kuzong ga Jesús tek tjwe irbo e go miydarashko ga jek zron jong ba bäm go këm jũni. Ga tjyono jem kjor jong eshko kjl̈ara l̈i ko roy, ĩya wẽl̈ë wl̈o.
Jesús jek shäng irbo e goshko ga ĩya sök kjomo, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Zaqueo, pja opl̈õs kjwey dwayo ter töshko mal̈ing. Eeri ga tja ber sök bop ushko» l̈e.
Kuya ga opl̈ono ter töshko mal̈ing, ga Jesús wl̈okjrara shäng wopjl̈úe.
Eni ga ĩya l̈öng eshko l̈irë ga Jesús l̈ãywe l̈ok owa ara. Tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ëng kong ga «Domer kjwe l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryaga. ¿Jesús kjwe jek ba ushko l̇l̇ëno?» l̈e l̈ok eni.

Eshko ga Zaqueo kojongö shäng, tjl̈ẽ Jesús kong ga «Tjl̈apga, bor l̇l̇ëbo tjeng kës l̈i twër bëy oba song wl̈eniyo kong. Ga ëbo l̇l̇ëbo l̈ũyotkoror jyãpgwër ĩ wl̈eni ga ãska twër iröng bayo l̇l̇ëbo kjroror l̈i pjl̈ogl̈o pkëng (4)» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Eeri ga pja döktong, bop pjeyoga l̈öng bop ushko l̈i tjok. Jl̈õkoyo ga pja Abraham tjëyo.
No to ter kjok dogo dwayo ëre shrono shäng no jeno l̈öng wl̈eniyo, e wl̈ẽga, e döga» l̈e.
Parkagaga dogl̈o mya

Jesús jek jëk shäng ääto Jerusalén kjokyoshko ga nopga jëk l̈öng ara ba tjok, l̇l̇ëye l̈e l̈i kuya l̈ok wl̈o. Wotjl̈ĩk l̈ok ga äär Jerusalén kjokyo ga Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo dbaryo l̈i eshkoro l̈ara. Miga eni l̇l̇ëme. E kjĩshko ga Jesús tjl̈ẽno ba kong l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go.
Tjl̈ẽ ga «Pjl̈ara ga domer shäng kjl̈ara, tjwl̈õ ara wl̈eniyo. To kjok shto obl̈ë pjola, iëba ber sök ba kjokshko sopga pjl̈uyo wl̈o, ga tjwe iröng ba kjokshko wl̈o l̈e.

Opshiydë l̇l̇ëm obishko ga ba parkagaga rokara dogl̈o sak kjwara (10). Kjl̈ara kjl̈ara kong dbur twara bayo ara, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong l̈ok ga “Pjãy ber l̈öng dbur shak ëre go, tja tjwe iröng obi guing” l̈e ba kong, ga toe.
»Gueniyo ĩywa kjok eshko sopga l̈irë shjiktëng. E kjĩshko ga nopga ichara kjl̈öbö ba irgo, tjl̈ẽ ga “Kjwe woydërwa ber borwa pjl̈uyo l̇l̇ëme” l̈e l̈ok eni.
Woydara l̈ok eni l̇l̇ëm ëmdë ga iaraba beno sök ba pjl̈uyo. »E irgo ga tek shrono iröng ba kjokshko. Shrono shäng ga ba parkagaga kong dbur twara l̈i, e rokara, dbur shano e go kjöme miyde wl̈o.
»Parkaga shrono shäng bäm go l̈i tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Tjl̈apga, bop dbur tworop bor kong l̈i go ga kjingsho sharor kjringgwo sak kjwara (10) obi” l̈e.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Pjl̈úe. Pja parkaga pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo. Pja kong l̇l̇ëbo tworor chira, ga dorop pjl̈o beke. E kjĩshko ga pja iër ber no ichaga kjok kjringgwo sak kjwara (10)” l̈e.
»E irgo ga parkaga shrono shäng kjl̈ara obi, tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Tjl̈apga, bop dbur tworop bor kong l̈i go ga kjingsho sharor kjringgwo shkëng (5) obi” l̈e.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Eni ga pja iër ber no ichaga kjok kjringgwo shkëng (5)” l̈e.
»E irgo ga parkaga shrono shäng kjl̈ara obi, tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Tjl̈apga, bop dbur tworop bor kong kjupargue l̈i kjros iröng. Popgoror beno tjeng jangsher roshko, jer l̇l̇ëm wl̈o.
Miydër pjl̈ú ga pja kjange. Pja parkono l̇l̇ëmshko ga pja dbur shak eshko, ga pja dwl̈a bo kjrë, dwl̈a dgorop l̇l̇ëmshko bakoe. E kjĩshko ga pja bangkjroror ara” l̈e.

»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Pja parkaga owa wl̈eniyo. Pja l̇l̇gwer, tjl̈õkwo l̈ëp shäng om go l̈i go. Miydëp pjl̈ú ga tja kjange. Tja parkono l̇l̇ëmshko ga tja dbur shak eshko, ga tja dwl̈a bo kjrë, dwl̈a dgoror l̇l̇ëmshko bakoe.
E kjĩshko ga bor dbur ëre sörop, jnenop beno dbur jnezl̈ong uyo roshko kjwe dey. Eni kjwe ga tja tjwe iröng obi ga tja dbur töno e kjinmo kjwe” l̈e ba kong.
»Eshko ga pjl̈u l̈i tjl̈ẽ ba parkagaga obl̈ë l̈öng eshko l̈i kong ga “Ba dbur tjeng ba wl̈oshko kjwe dözĩ, twozĩ kjl̈ara shäng dbur shara kjringgwo sak kjwara (10) l̈i kong” l̈e.
»Kuya l̈ok ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Tjl̈apga, kjwera dbur tjeng kjringgwo sak kjwara (10) tjän” l̈e.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “L̈ër bomi kong ga ëye l̇l̇ëbo tjok ga së̃ya jek obi. Ëye l̇l̇ëye l̇l̇ëm ga l̇l̇ëye tjeng sirawa l̈i döya ba shjiryo drete.
E ga bor wl̈oyoga l̈ira, tja woydara ber ba pjl̈uyo l̇l̇ëme. Epgara to shami, ga tek sözĩ, zrömi bor bokshto wl̈o”» l̈e.
Jesús öötong opzrëno jek Jerusalén kjokyo, pjl̈u wl̈eni
Jesús tjl̈ẽno eni pjir ga jek jongya Jerusalén kjokyo obi,
ga öötong shäng Betfagé kjokyo, Betania kjokyo, e ber l̈öng Olivos dl̈upyo pogl̈o go. Eshko ga ba oppinggaga jek l̈öng ba tjok l̈i rokara do pjök,

ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pjãy nom kjok buk bi bokshto kjweshko. Eshko ga öng so kwomgl̈a kjoyo dre töshko l̇l̇gwokl̈ë wl̈eniyo wl̈ẽmi sök kjro go kjl̈ara wl̈ënggl̈a, kjing go ëye opyoydë l̇l̇ëm wl̈eniyo. Komi, ga tek sömi bor kong.
Eshko ga ëbo tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga “¿Komi kjweni ega?” l̈e bomi kong wl̈eni ga “Woyde Tjl̈apgarë” l̈ëmi ba kong eni» l̈e.
Eni ga jek öötong l̈öng eshko, ga öng wl̈ẽna sök kjl̈ara, l̈ara ba kong sorë l̈i eni.
Kõya l̈öngshko ga ĩya ba sogogarë ga tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ba kong ga «¿Öng kjwe komi l̇l̇ëno?»
«Woyde Tjl̈apgarë» l̈e ba kong.
Eni ga öng l̈i tek söra shrono l̈öng Jesús kong, ga ba shwong kop l̈ëkong iara l̈ok öng l̈i kokso kjing go. Eshko ga Jesús kjimtara l̈ok opyë sök öng l̈i kjing go, ga jeke.
Jek sökshko ga nopga jëk l̈öng ba tjok ara. Kjone kjone, ba shwong kop l̈ëkong skwara l̈ok, ga kwoptara l̈ok irbo bäng go ba bäm go.
Jek sök ääto kjujõzl̈ong irboyoshko ga nopga jëk l̈öng ba tjok l̈i, öö l̈e l̈ok, wopjl̈ú kjĩshko. Ga Sbö poshrëya l̈ok träk l̇l̇ëm, l̇l̇ëbo ĩydëba l̇l̇ëm wl̈eniyo ĩna l̈ok ara kjĩshko.
Tjl̈ẽ ga

content.text: «Pjl̈u kjwe ichara Tjl̈apgarë shrono kjok ëreshko.
L̈öng kjok dogo l̈i l̈öng wopjl̈ú Sbö tjok,
“Pja kësbange” l̈e l̈ok ba kong» l̈e.

content: Fariseoga l̈öng eshko kjl̈öbö, nopga l̈i tjrëko. Kuya l̈ok ga tjl̈ẽ Jesús kong ga «Tjl̈apga no pingga, bop oppinggaga kjwe kjinkozong» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «L̈ër bomi kong ga kjwepga kjinkoror kjwe ga akkwo tjeng kjwey, öö l̈e shara» l̈e.
Jek sök ääto Jerusalén kjokyo ga kjok l̈i ĩna, ga sl̈atong ara,
tjl̈ẽ ga «Jerusalén sopga, pjãy iaga ber l̈öng wl̈ẽp l̈i ë, e miydomirë l̇l̇ëm obi. Woydoror ga miydoromi tjän, gueniyo jnek tjeng pjir bomi kong, miydëmi l̇l̇ëm wl̈o.

Sbö shrono sök bomi ĩkshko ga wl̈okjroromi l̇l̇ëme. E kjĩshko ga dbar tjwe bomi kong owa kjrina. Eshko ga pjãy popde bomi moskwogarë l̈ok, ga pjãy kopjrĩya l̈ok pjribri, pjãy opshik tök l̇l̇aw l̇l̇ëm wl̈o. Bomi kjok kjëryo shäryak ak go pjribri kjókshko kjwe dl̈oya l̈ok ber tjeng töshko, akkwo ëmdë ber tjeng ëng kjing go kjwara l̇l̇ëme. Eshko ga pjãy zröya l̈ok» l̈e.
L̇l̇ëbo soynegaga l̈öng Sbö u zl̈ong bäng l̈i ichara Jesúsdë drete
Jesús opzrëno jek Jerusalén kjokyo roshko irgo ga öötong shäng Sbö u zl̈ong bäng ga nopga l̈öng eshko l̇l̇ëbo soynek l̈i ichara opshik ey dwayo,
tjl̈ẽ ga «Sbö tjl̈õkwo tak pjang eni: “Bor u, e kowëba ber syõ uyo wl̈o.
Gueniyo ioromi beno jong l̈ũ uyo”»
l̈e.

Dbar kjwobi go ga Jesús öör shäng nopga ping Sbö u zl̈ong bäng. Ga syõshtaga kägäyoga, no pinggaga kjok l̇l̇gwekkl̈o tara Moisésdë l̈i go, tjl̈apgaga tjwl̈õ ara wl̈eniyo, e tjl̈ẽ ëng kong ga «¿Zröy sorë ga pjl̈ú?» l̈e l̈ok eni enido.
Gueniyo shaya l̈ok ga ä, Jesús zl̈ong bäng nopga l̈öng ara ba kuk kjĩshko.
